Delete Account?

Your account is hidden straight away and erased after 7 days. Changed your mind? Sign back in before then and tap Keep My Account. After that it can't be undone. It removes:

  • • Account sign-in
  • • Ranked rating & stats
  • • Friends list
  • • Diamonds, items and challenges
  • • Saved preferences
